_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0% 12h movement base rate over 73 windows makes HOLD the only statistically honest call — the coil has not broken and no brain has produced a confirmed breaker signal.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial split — both ultimately signal HOLD, but the analyst forward-calls Disbelief (illegal 2-rung jump) while the narrative implies a bullish reversal is imminent; the judge overrides to keep the forward phase within ±1 rung of Denial.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC funding drops below 0.003% with CVD holding 70+ and price grinds above $66k — signals Denial→Disbelief transition with real demand entering.
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX breaks 20 with DXY above 101 and BTC loses $61k — pushes to Anxiety/Panic leg, confirming gold/VIX safety bid was early risk-off, not late-cycle noise.
